rule: V7 is the only destination and the only supported runtime generation. Aggressively remove V3/V4/V5/V6 runtime, config, workflow, test, adapter, monitoring, deployment and documentation surfaces. Preserve only V7 and generation-neutral/common primitives that V7 imports. Do not restore legacy compatibility wrappers. PAPER-only safety remains mandatory; authenticated_execution=false and real_order_submission=false.

paper_v7_authorization.interpretation: 100% is a hard ceiling, not a target. Kelly, executable depth, authoritative fees, spread/slippage, inventory and unwind risk, adverse markout, capital/latency costs, state integrity and the 15% drawdown kill switch still bind.

architecture.target: one slim canonical V7 PAPER codebase
architecture.legacy_rule: Quarantine obsolete operational generations immediately, but physically delete only after any unique useful capability is ported to V7 and the exact replacement is green on main and healthy in live-PAPER. Git history is the archive.

economic_objective.decision_ev: P(fill_or_joint_completion|X,a) * E[alpha_or_spread_capture-costs-adverse_markout|fill,X,a] - E[partial_or_inventory_unwind_loss|X,a] - capital_cost - latency_cost + conservatively_haircut_maker_rebate + conservatively_haircut_liquidity_reward
economic_objective.multi_leg_rule: Estimate the empirical joint completion/state distribution; product or minimum of marginal fill probabilities is not an accepted substitute.
economic_objective.success: positive forward realized PAPER fill-conditioned post-cost PnL with causal data, realistic simulated fills, authoritative fees, executable depth, inventory/unwind losses, markout, reward/rebate attribution, cost stress and no leakage
